load packages

load object

fileNam <- "/Users/immbio/Desktop/HumanHeartCarTrans2/data/Human_heart_allmerged_seurat_clean.rds"
seuratM <- readRDS(fileNam)
### diseaseCond
seuratM$diseaseCond <- "diseaseCond"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V1|V2|353921_12-12_20240515_Hu_nucseq_USZ_EMB010_V1_2", seuratM$dataset)] <- "PP"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V3", seuratM$dataset)& !(seuratM$dataset %in% "384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3")] <- "visit3" #Exclude rejection sample CarTrans019/3 from visit3 
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V4", seuratM$dataset)& !(seuratM$dataset %in% "372561_10-10_20241204_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx007_V4")] <- "visit4" #Exclude rejection sample CarTrans007/4 from visit4
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V5", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit5" 
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("VX1|VX2|VX3|VX4|384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3|372561_10-10_20241204_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx007_V4", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visitX"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("HH", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Donorheart"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("RV|LV|expLV|expRV|331571_3-5_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx001|331571_4-6_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx002", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Explant"


table(seuratM$diseaseCond)

table(seuratM$diseaseCond)

order_keywords <- c("visit3", "visit4", "visit5", "visitX")
files <- unique(seuratM$patient_diseaseCond)
ordered_files <- c()
for (key in order_keywords) {
  ordered_files <- c(ordered_files, files[grepl(key, files)])
}

###patient_diseaseCond
datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$patient_diseaseCond)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, patient_diseaseCond==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(patient_diseaseCond=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

# CarTrans 14: V3 3.3% (0R), V4 1.8% (0R) V5 20% (1R)

# CarTrans 21: V4 3.5% (0R), V5 4.9% (1R) (V3 not in dataset)

#Definition of T cell thresholds -NCR paper:
#Low <3%, Intermediate 3-6%, High >6%

# Tcell 4% in Explant
# Tcell 8.9% in ACR0
# Tcell 14.8% in ACR1R
# Tcell 27.8% in ACR2R
# Tcell 26.8% in ACR3R
# Tcell 1.4% in Donorheart

# Tcell 0.12 in PP
# Tcell 0.30 in RP
# Tcell 0.22 in CP

# Tcell 1.4% in donorheart
# Tcell 4% in explant
# Tcell 13% in V1
# Tcell 12% in V2
# Tcell 5% in V3 with exclusion 
# Tcell 17% in V4
# Tcell 9% in V5
# Tcell 33% in VX
order_keywords <- c("V3", "V4", "V5", "VX1|VX2|VX3|VX4|384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3")
files <- unique(seuratM$dataset)
ordered_files <- c()
for (key in order_keywords) {
  ordered_files <- c(ordered_files, files[grepl(key, files)])
}

###dataset
datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$dataset)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, dataset==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(dataset=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

# T cell Subgroups: T cell abundance >= 6% Rejection Phase, T cell abundance < 6% Convalescence Phase
dat_all_sample_Tcell_sub$Tcg[dat_all_sample_Tcell_sub$percent >= 0.155] <- "rejection"
dat_all_sample_Tcell_sub$Tcg[dat_all_sample_Tcell_sub$percent < 0.155] <- "no_rejection"
